notes.title: version 1.1.12 update
notes.notes:
加入一个小操作：
选中一个碎片时，按鼠标右键即可旋转碎片，这样不用键盘，单手也可愉快的进行游戏。
---------------------------------------------------
Add a small operation:
When a piece is selected, press the right mouse button to rotate the pieces, so that you can play the game happily with one hand without using the keyboard.

notes.title: version 1.1.11 update
notes.notes:
Version 1.1.11 update
1. Re-adjust the unlocking style and the number of PPs in the puzzle
   (The number required is reduced, so everyone can happily unlock all kinds of puzzles)
2. Re-adjust the number of PPs that complete the puzzle reward
    (Complete a puzzle to get PP=level X2)
3. Customize the puzzle when the puzzle selection box is better
4. Adjust the expression of the mascot, now it is more happy
---------------------------------------------------------
版本1.1.11更新
1.重新调整解锁样式和拼图的PP数量
  （所需数量都减少了，这样大家就可以愉快的解锁各类拼图）
2.重新调整完成拼图奖励的PP数量
   （完成一幅拼图获得PP=等级X2）
3.自定义拼图时的拼图选择框更加好看了
4.调整吉祥物的表情，现在它变得更高兴了
